subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When the planner freezes a plan/v2 task for `/implement-now`, the planner shall record at least one resolvable evidence citation supporting its assessment values.
rationale: the assessment must preserve why every executor task was classified, not only its labels
fit_criterion: uncited or unresolved evidence fails plan validation before freeze; EVAL-1 proves that every recorded assessment value is supported by at least one cited anchor and rejects irrelevant, contradictory, or only partially supporting citation sets without requiring a distinct citation per axis
